description: This file defines and exports functions related to plugin SDK entry points, such as building source paths, specifiers, package exports, and distribution artifacts, based on a JSON list of plugin entry points.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkEntrySources
methods.description: Generates a mapping from plugin entry names to their source file paths within the project.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkSpecifiers
methods.description: Creates import specifiers for plugin SDK modules based on entry names.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkPackageExports
methods.description: Produces a mapping for package exports, linking entry points to their type declaration and JavaScript files.

methods.name: listPluginSdkDistArtifacts
methods.description: Lists distribution artifact paths (JavaScript and type declaration files) for all plugin entries.
